imageNotes: Ten usable public owner-account stills from twelve rendered Instagram grid images exported by root through pageAssets. Pinned text posters02and03 excluded from website. Item01 is a store/team reference only, not a product listing. Items04–12 illustrate nine catalogue styling groups; some labels mention sets but bundle contents are unconfirmed. All are native image/Reel-cover JPEGs; no video frames extracted. No prices, material composition, authenticity, sizes or current stock inferred. Public telephone is not explicitly a WhatsApp contact, so site enquiries must use Instagram. Prefer portrait-contain layouts for these covers.
